text:
mona: Heads-up — HyperServe launched an 'AutoTune' hero claim: 'zero tuning, instant best latency' with a glossy p50 chart. Need SDR one-liners + a webinar micro-slide by EOD. :eyes:

zane: paste the ad/link? want exact wording.

tara: linked. main claims: 'AutoTune', 'zero tuning', 'same perf on any GPU'.

li: short framing: great marketing but misleading — auto-tuning still trades on model shape, KV cache, batching, and routing.

mona: SDR lines must be 1 sentence each. Give me tech and biz variants.

zane: drafts (super short):
- Tech: "We tune runtime to your model and traffic for more predictable production latency."
- Biz: "Predictable latency and transparent unit-cost controls across deployment types."

tara: webinar micro-slide (3 bullets):
1) Serving-first runtime: kernel selection, batching, KV cache
2) Cost levers: batching, caching, quantization suggestions
3) Ops visibility: token-level cost & latency breakdowns

li: legal note: avoid 'tail latency' and specific numbers unless ops signs off. use 'more predictable' or 'improved'.

mona: action items:
- @zane: drop final two SDR one-liners in Notion by 4pm PT
- @tara: make 1-slide with the 3 bullets + 1-line note on why 'zero tuning' can be misleading by COB
- @li: quick legal check on phrasing and flag no-go words

ops-bot: Reminder set: Notion + slide drafts due 16:00 PT today (channel: #marketing).

mona: Keep it short, human, and verifiable. :thumbsup:
